notes: Slow squats now count: the live squat counter used to measure your dip against the oldest frame in a 2-second window, so the baseline slid down with you — a slow 3–4 second descent never counted as a rep at all, and a long hold at the bottom counted the rep while you were still down there and zeroed the Depth score. The counter now measures against your held standing height, tracked only while you are standing, so a slow descent counts on the way back up and a hold at the bottom counts only when you stand. One glitched frame still can't move the baseline.
